description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - New Sport - Teqball
reasoning: This gazette contains an order made by the Minister of Education, Sports and Youth Affairs under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which amends a previous order by adding a new sport (Teqball) to Schedule II. This constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
